name: Green Tea Fresh Cleanser
productInfo: This refreshing gel cleanser is formulated with Jeju-sourced green tea extract to deeply cleanse while maintaining skin hydration. Its Anti-Sebum P complex helps control oil and refine texture, making it ideal for oily skin.
howToUse: Dispense an appropriate amount onto your palm and lather up with water. Gently massage over the entire face. Rinse off thoroughly with warm water.
benefits: Gently cleanses without stripping moisture, hydrates with 4 kinds of hyaluronic acid and controls excess sebum and smooths skin texture.
